thread:
maddy: Quick sync — prelaunch checklist for tomorrow's webinar + seed blog + launch posts. Need final KW matrix, JSON-LD schema, internal linking map, and a redirect plan. Can we lock owners by EOD?

ravi: I can own redirects if sam can confirm URL patterns. :+1:

olivia: I updated the KW sheet -> https://tiny.example/kw-matrix (final col: intent + funnel). Took a pass at schema too.

sam: Linking concern: we have /resources/webinar -> currently canonical to /blog/webinar-digest. If we launch a separate webinar landing, we'll need a 301 plan. Example URLs: /webinars/product-launch-2026 and /blog/2026/product-launch-webinar.

seo-bot: crawl-scan complete: 8 pages flagged for duplicate meta titles, 2 pages with missing JSON-LD. See report: https://tiny.example/crawl-report

maddy: Olivia — can you paste the schema snippet we want on the webinar landing? Keep it minimal (Event + sameAs org).

olivia: sure, pasted below; we'll add startDate and url.

olivia: ```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "WebPage",
  "name": "Redwood Inference — Webinar: Serving LLMs at Scale",
  "description": "Live demo + benchmarks on serving LLMs with predictable latency and cost.",
  "mainEntity": {
    "@type": "Event",
    "name": "Serving LLMs at Scale",
    "startDate": "2026-03-25T16:00:00Z",
    "location": {
      "@type": "VirtualLocation",
      "url": "https://redwood.example/webinars/serving-llms"
    }
  }
}
```

ravi: Thanks — that looks good. For redirects, propose rule set:
```
# redirect rules (nginx):
location = /webinars/product-launch-2026 { return 301 /webinars/serving-llms; }
rewrite ^/blog/2026/product-launch-webinar$ /webinars/serving-llms permanent;
```

sam: A quick ask: any anchor + internal link plan for the seed posts? We should add 3 contextual links from pillar blog -> webinar landing and 1 from product docs.

maddy: Agreed. Olivia, can you sketch the internal linking map in the KW sheet under 'linking plan'? Target CTAs: Register / Watch on-demand / Contact sales. Messaging variations: Register CTA should be benefit-driven (lower latency + cost).

olivia: Done. Added suggested anchor texts and suggested pages for inbound routing (utm params). Example UTM: ?utm_source=webinar_email&utm_campaign=serving_llms_launch

seo-bot: Suggestion: add structured data for FAQ on the webinar landing for better SERP real estate. 2 FAQs max.

maddy: Good call. Keep copy team in the loop — @ravi will you coordinate messaging iteration with copy? We need final CTAs + one-line benefit for hero.

ravi: Yep, will sync with copy and post final hero line here by 18:00.

sam: I'll scope the redirect work and deploy a short-lived canary; putting a PR with nginx rules by 15:30. Will add smoke test steps.

olivia: I'll push schema + FAQ snippet to the landing branch and add a unit test to verify JSON-LD injection.

maddy: Timeline check: redirects PR by 15:30, schema + linking map by 16:30, messaging locked by 18:00, final QA pass 20:00, go-live tomorrow 10:00 PT. Any blockers? :eyes:

ravi: none from me.

sam: No blockers; might need a quick eng review for nginx reload window.

olivia: All good. Adding a small regression eval to ensure titles don't regress after canonical changes.

maddy: Awesome — thanks team. :party_parrot: We'll reconvene here if anything slips.
